results.content: ## Article preview. # Analytical solution to and error analysis of the quaternion based similarity transformation considering measurement errors in both frames. An analytical solution is derived based on eigen decomposition. The similarity transformation between two coordinate frames, is widely adopted in science and engineering. One model is employed only because it is useful, but not because it is true. Besides the similarity model, there are many others in the literature, often more complicated. In the predetermined similarity model, three different sub-transformations are included, named the translation, the rotation, and the isotropic scale. It is natural to represent the translation and the scale as a 3 × 1 vector and a positive scalar, respectively. As a final note, extensive practical usage of the quaternion can be found in the GOCE mission with the so-called “Earth Orientation Quaternions” to represent the rotation between the Earth-Fixed Reference Frame and Inertial Reference Frame [18]. A stochastic model about the measurement errors should be assumed in order to conduct a statistically meaningful inference. The resulted error model is often called the error-in-variables (EIV) model [19]. Second, it makes the problem tractable, furthermore, simple and efficient algorithms, such as the analytical ones, can be developed under the Gaussian assumption. When applied to the EIV model, the least-squares method is also called the total least-squares method [21].
